To clarify these conditions, the following definitions will be used: LO : Lower Overtemperature Value = TSET - OD UO : Upper Overtemperature Value = TSET + OD If T = LO or UO = T then the THEMAS system shall recognize this condition as the temperature limit has been exceeded.
